tool_input.command:
R=/tmp/smoothmag-admin-verify
printf '{"master_key": "%s"}\n' "$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64)" > "$R/notification.json"
cat > "$R/capture-mail.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '===MAIL ARGS: %s\n' "$*" >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail.log
cat >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail.log
printf '\n' >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail.log
exit 0
EOF
cat > "$R/capture-mail-fail.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '===MAIL ARGS: %s\n' "$*" >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail-fail.log
cat >> /runtime/mail/captured-mail-fail.log
exit 1
EOF
cat > "$R/refresh-source.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Re-copy canonical working-tree bytes into the throwaway runtime docroot.
set -e
REPO=$HOME/.hermes/profiles/agent-smooth/smoothmag-web-Webhooks
R=/tmp/smoothmag-admin-verify
rm -rf "$R/root/smoothmag/admin" "$R/root/smoothmag/common"
cp -a "$REPO/public_html/admin" "$R/root/smoothmag/admin"
cp -a "$REPO/public_html/common" "$R/root/smoothmag/common"
cp -a "$REPO/public_html/images/logo.png" "$R/root/smoothmag/images/logo.png"
cp -a "$REPO/dev/router.php" "$R/root/router.php"
md5sum "$R"/root/smoothmag/admin/assets/css/custom.css "$R"/root/smoothmag/admin/manage-notifications.php "$R"/root/smoothmag/admin/manage-administrators.php
echo "refreshed $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
EOF
chmod +x "$R/capture-mail.sh" "$R/capture-mail-fail.sh" "$R/refresh-source.sh"
cat > "$R/phpimg/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
FROM php:8.2-cli
RUN docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql pcntl
EOF
docker build -q -t smooth-admin-verify-php-img "$R/phpimg"
